submission.natural_language_explanation: A default-on 'non-content token' dial: the pole sits at its GELU-dip ceiling (0.14-0.17) on most tokens with mild negative pre-activation, namely articles, prepositions, auxiliaries, pronouns, whitespace/indentation runs, newlines, numbers and mid-word fragments (' the', ' of', ' a', ' is', ' believe', ' ', '\n'). It drops to ~0 on content words that open a new phrase, such as nouns, verbs and adjectives after 'to'/'the'/'for'/'about' and wh-words ' how'/' what' (e.g. 'to [help]', 'about [mental]'), and on the first 1-3 tokens of a document. It falls to a partial 0.03-0.09 on tokens whose pre-activation overshoots strongly negative: hyphens inside compounds, possessive 's, ' and', ' in', commas and periods. Since nearly every passage has some function word, a window's peak is almost always at the 0.17 ceiling; only short, all-content prompts stay low.
